findings.existingSupport: Indexed triangleList with explicit normals, public indexed box/sphere/etc factories, ordinary shared-source ECS transforms and renderer instancing already exist. Do not characterize them as absent.
findings.narrowGap: Documented public mesh asset exports have no typed primitive-part assembly, affine bake/merge or packed typed indexed builder that preserves normals/UVs/tangents/indices/material ranges. TriangleList high-level input is nested tuples; custom tangent data requires lower-level MeshAsset streams. This makes material-batched arbitrary parts require manual buffer/layout math.
findings.proposal: After completion freeze, evaluate a general typed source-geometry assembly helper: affine transformed primitive parts or packed typed indexed data; correct inverse-transpose normals, mirror winding/tangent handedness, index rebasing/uint16->uint32, compatible full attribute retention, material/submesh ranges and bounded validation. Keep an explicit shared-source ECS path rather than baking repeatable parts. First add indexed/shared primitive examples and vertex/index/per-material cost diagnostics. No house-specific recipe, automatic mesh rewrite, or invented existing API.
